source_caption:
Which wolf are you feeding today?

Cole’s words in 12 Monkeys aren’t about good vs evil, or strength vs weakness. They’re about choice. The anger, envy, and pride inside us don’t disappear and neither do truth, kindness, or hope. They exist together, tearing at each other every day. The only thing that decides who wins is what you give your attention, your energy, your time.

12 Monkeys is more than time travel and apocalypses. It’s a deeply philosophical sci-fi series about free will, cycles, trauma, and responsibility. Scenes like this are why the show quietly became one of the smartest, most underrated sci-fi stories ever told... brutal in ideas, human at its core.
